description: Automation Health Dashboard â€” composite view of UI Bridge automation quality. Shows health score gauge, improvement recommendations, element reliability heatmap, action performance baselines, failure taxonomy, automation regressions, stall frequency, intervention effectiveness, and annotation gaps. Powered by cross-run analytics from ui_bridge_events (element interactions persisted per action with duration, success, error). Data flows: action handler â†’ insert_ui_bridge_event â†’ SQLite â†’ 17 analytics SQL queries â†’ 13 MCP endpoints â†’ React hooks â†’ dashboard panels. Health score is a weighted composite: 0.30 * element_success_rate + 0.25 * (1 - regression_rate) + 0.25 * (1 - stall_frequency) + 0.20 base. Recommendations are rule-based: flaky elements â†’ add data-testid, stalls â†’ increase settle_delay, unannotated â†’ add annotations, high failure rate â†’ review taxonomy.

groups.description: Analytics data reflects recent UI Bridge interactions. When actions are performed with ?task_run_id= query parameter on the /ui-bridge/control/element/{id}/action endpoint, they are persisted to ui_bridge_events via spawn_blocking. The dashboard should show non-zero interaction counts within seconds of actions being performed. Changing the time range should filter all panels. The health score should decrease when failures are introduced.
groups.name: Data Freshness and Pipeline Behavior

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Backend Data Pipeline Architecture

target.label: Required element for Backend Data Pipeline Architecture

groups.description: Architecture: UI Bridge action handlers (mcp/ui_bridge.rs, mcp/sdk_client.rs) persist events to ui_bridge_events table via insert_ui_bridge_event() when ?task_run_id= query param is present. Events flow through 17 SQL query functions in database/ui_bridge_ops.rs, exposed via 13 MCP HTTP endpoints under /ui-bridge/analytics/*. The knowledge graph (reflection/graph_engine.rs) loads UIElement nodes and InteractedWith edges for causal analysis. The stall detector (orchestration_loop/stall_detector.rs) fetches /ui-bridge/control/health-signals to detect UIStuck patterns. Token attribution flows through phase_token_usage.target_app. CTR auto-seeding pushes reliability data to SDK apps on connect.
groups.name: Backend Data Pipeline Architecture
